caseName: Nev. Dep't of Wildlife v. Smith
caseNameFull: NEVADA DEPARTMENT OF WILDLIFE v. Mark E. SMITH.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeal of California, Third Appellate District. Petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the Court of Appeal of California, Third Appellate District for further consideration in light of Franchise Tax Bd. of Cal. v. Hyatt, 587 U.S. ----, 139 S.Ct. 1485, --- L.E.2d ---- (2019).
